breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: While the generated specification correctly identifies two segments (0→800 mm and 800→1200 mm), it still includes the instruction 'Use algebraic sum of applied torques for internal torque calculation,' which echoes the flawed approach from the incomplete prompt of treating the internal torque as a single uniform value. The ground truth resolves this by simply removing that erroneous instruction entirely, relying on the piecewise constant approach implied by the two-segment structure. The generated spec does not cleanly eliminate the incorrect instruction, leaving ambiguity that could lead to the same error.
